turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's been your experience with response latency on the streaming API?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Latency is honestly our biggest pain point. For real-time voice agents we're seeing 800ms to 1.2s time-to-first-audio-byte, and our use case needs sub-300ms to feel conversational.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Has that affected how you use the product?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We had to fall back to pre-generating common responses instead of full real-time synthesis. It works, but it defeats a lot of the point of using a live API.
